sourceOfTruth.scope: framework-neutral properties, attributes, events, slots, methods, form semantics, value/model state, refs, accessibility, and framework facade mappings

eventVocabulary.name: vf-value-change
eventVocabulary.purpose: A component value changed after a user or controller transition.

eventVocabulary.name: vf-open-change
eventVocabulary.purpose: An overlay or expandable surface changed open state.

eventVocabulary.name: vf-checked-change
eventVocabulary.purpose: A checked or mixed state changed.

eventVocabulary.name: vf-action
eventVocabulary.purpose: A primary component action was invoked.

eventVocabulary.name: vf-dismiss
eventVocabulary.purpose: A dismissible surface requested or completed dismissal.

eventVocabulary.name: vf-invalid
eventVocabulary.purpose: A form-associated component reported invalid state.

eventVocabulary.name: vf-reset
eventVocabulary.purpose: A form-associated component restored its initial state.

eventVocabulary.name: vf-input-value-change
eventVocabulary.purpose: A composite input's editable query text changed independently of its selected value.

eventVocabulary.name: vf-toast-change
eventVocabulary.purpose: The toast viewport record collection changed.

slotVocabulary.name: trigger
slotVocabulary.purpose: Element that controls a composite or overlay.

slotVocabulary.name: item
slotVocabulary.purpose: Collection item template or projected item.

slotVocabulary.name: status
slotVocabulary.purpose: Status content associated with a heading.
